events.title: The link test on aifoundry1 card 0
events.text: The owner’s session ran the link test from the lab report (U25): two readings of card 0’s corrected link errors at 16 GT/s, a minute apart, then a retrain of the link at 8 GT/s, with the card idle and locked. The plan said a failed retrain would drop only card 0.

events.title: aifoundry1 hung
events.text: At the retrain the whole host stopped: no more output, no network. The neighbor’s read-only check found it gone at 14:42, watched for it from 14:45 and confirmed it dead at 14:48; the owner reported it at 14:47.

events.title: The power cycle
events.text: The lab lead switched all three machines off and on at about 15:07 (boots at 15:07:10–15:07:35). The reboot of aifoundry2 stopped both sessions there until 15:18 and 15:22 and cleared its /tmp: about 19 GB of working files, this timeline’s working folder among them.

events.title: The investigation
events.text: Back at 15:18, the neighbor reads the three hosts’ boot records, card 0’s link counters (16 GT/s x8 again, no corrected errors where there had been about one a second for twelve days) and the crash store (empty: a hard hang, not a panic), and what the power cycle cleared.

events.title: Published: A PCIe link retrain hung aifoundry1
events.text: A deploy of the public page A PCIe link retrain hung aifoundry1 (spacesheep.dev/@yaroslavvb/aifoundry1-link-retrain-hang).

events.title: A commit: 9120d62
events.text: Lesson: a PCIe link retrain (our Gen3 test of aifoundry1 card 0, 30 Sep 14:41) hung the whole host until the lab lead power-cycled the lab at 15:07; never retrain or re-speed a card's link on a running host (AGENT.md rules, 14-card-behaviour.md); the incident page (public, 11e77f93)

events.title: The dashboard kept public
events.text: At the owner’s word that the AI Foundry pages are public, the neighbor changed the lab dashboard’s updater, which had set the page private again on each run: it now keeps it public. The 16:02 run confirmed it.

hosts.title: aifoundry1 hung
hosts.text: The retrain of card 0’s link at 14:41:21 stopped the whole host, both cards with it, until the power cycle.

hosts.title: aifoundry1 power-cycled
hosts.text: The lab lead switched the machine off and on; it booted at 15:07:35, and card 0’s link trained at 16 GT/s again.

hosts.title: aifoundry2 power-cycled
hosts.text: Switched off and on with the others; it booted at 15:07:11. The sessions on it stopped until 15:08–15:22, and its /tmp was cleared.

hosts.title: aifoundry3 power-cycled
hosts.text: Switched off and on with the others; it booted at 15:07:10.
